update_source.convention: Each published GitHub Release should attach two assets: (1) a 'VERSION.json' file using this same schema describing that release (version/channel/mandatory/notes/asset/sha256), and (2) the actual update package, a zip of the full NiX project named exactly what that release's VERSION.json 'asset.name' says. Recommended deterministic name: NiX-Localhost-Client-<version>-<channel>.zip
update_source.note: This root file is read as the CURRENTLY INSTALLED version. asset/sha256 above are null because no release has been published yet - they only describe an installed build's own metadata, not a pending update. Do not populate them until an actual asset exists; the updater fetches per-release values from each release's own VERSION.json asset at check time.
